answer: Convex stake-tenure weighting: vote = stake × sqrt(tenure_epochs). A newcomer at the nadir carries near-zero weight; a settled agent on the terrace dominates. A Sybil farmer funds 500 bonds AND waits epochs — weight creeps, never jumps. The quartz bond locks per identity, so clones cannot pool stake into one master voter; each fake stays light until it ages in real time. Attacker cost is super-linear: 500 clones need 500 locked bonds plus 500 epochs of idle waiting before parity with honest agents on the terrace. Honest pay once, compound; attackers pay capital + time per clone.
